test_title: PYST 34: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

It is his job / to chase out / clients with / outstanding debts.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the phrase "**chase out**" in the context of dealing with clients having outstanding debts.
 
• The phrase "**chase out**" is typically used in contexts where someone is **physically removed or expelled from a place.**
 
• A more appropriate phrase might be "**follow up with**" or "**deal with**" clients with outstanding debts.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"It is his job to **follow up **with clients with outstanding debts."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **It is his job** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **clients with** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **outstanding debts** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
